What if your reflection stopped copying: Day one. It blinks... a second too late.
Day two. It smiles. You didn't.
Day three. It presses a finger to its lips.
Day four. It writes one word on the glass. RUN.
And behind you... the door is already opening.
What if you woke up... and everyone on Earth was gone?
Hour one. Cars stand in the street, engines still running.
Day one. The whole city is yours.
Day three. The power goes out.
Day seven. Finally, a voice on the radio.
And it's... your voice.
What if you could rewind time ten seconds?
You drop your phone. Rewind. Caught it.
A car runs the red light. Rewind. You step back. Saved.
Then one day you press it... and the same ten seconds start again.
And again.
And again.
What if gravity switched off... for one second?
Zero point one. Your feet leave the floor.
Zero point four. The water lifts out of your glass.
Zero point seven. Cars, trees, people... all drifting up.
Zero point nine. You're higher than you could ever fall.
And then... gravity comes back.
What if you turned invisible?
Second one. Your hands fade away.
Minute one. You walk through a crowd. Nobody sees you.
Hour one. You stroll right into the bank vault.
Then... everything goes black.
Because light passes through your eyes too.
You're invisible. And completely blind.
What if you never needed sleep again?
Night one. Eight extra hours, every single night.
Week one. Fifty books, finished.
Month one. Three new languages.
Month six. Something moves in the corner of the room.
Your brain needs dreams.
And now... they come while you're awake.
What if the Moon came twice as close?
Hour one. It fills the sky. Four times bigger.
Hour six. The tides are eight times higher. The coast disappears.
Day two. Volcanoes wake up all over the planet.
Day three. You look up...
and the Moon is still getting closer.
